mapper.select: SELECT s.*, st.`name` as shopTypeName, EXISTS (SELECT * FROM travel_collect WHERE data_id = s.id AND type = 4 and user_id = #{userId}) as isCollect FROM travel_shop s LEFT JOIN travel_shop_type st ON s.type_id = st.id where s.id = #{shopId}

SELECT s.*, st.`name` as shopTypeName, EXISTS (SELECT * FROM travel_collect WHERE data_id = s.id AND type = 4 and user_id = #{userId}) as isCollect FROM travel_shop s LEFT JOIN travel_shop_type st ON s.type_id = st.id where s.name like concat('%', #{keyword} ,'%') or s.intro like concat('%', #{keyword} ,'%') or s.province like concat('%', #{keyword} ,'%') or s.city like concat('%', #{keyword} ,'%') or s.region like concat('%', #{keyword} ,'%') or s.address like concat('%', #{keyword} ,'%') or s.tags like concat('%', #{keyword} ,'%') order by s.create_time desc
